items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Mike DeLay was one of the fellas used to play him, and Albert Fernandes.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, we can figure it out.

Yes. And there was another one on St. Charles and Canal. I went in that one once, but... Mike DeLay was one of the fellas used to play him, and Albert Fernandes. I remember Albert Fernandes. He would... When Clarence took a break, he'd jump on the piano. Mm-hmm. And... Oh, because Clarence was playing banjo with him too, and he would jump on it. And Mike, he would get on the piano, and Albert would play trumpet. Mm-hmm. And there was one of those brothers, a hell of a musician alto player. There was quite a few…
